profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (Nasdaq: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that describes itself as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. Its site presents services and platforms aimed at CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers, covering areas including Zero Trust implementation, network security, cloud workload protection, hybrid workforce security, and threat intelligence.

The company's tracked AI product is Precision AI, positioned as a network security AI system with Zero Trust integration, autonomous threat response capabilities, and a focus on critical infrastructure. The site also references the Strata Network Security Platform, described as built for Zero Trust and powered by AI to monitor, analyze, and prevent threats in real time, as well as an AI-driven SecOps platform built around unified data, artificial intelligence, and automation. Additionally, the site introduces Idira, described as a next-generation identity security platform intended to secure every identity for the AI enterprise.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC enforcement actions, or patent filings appear in the held facts beyond the company's standard public-company registration details.
